My 15-Day Ear Treatment Journey

I want to share my experience because it might help someone facing the same problem.

It started when I had severe pain in my ear and didn’t know what to do. I decided to put a few drops of oil in my ear. After two days, the pain went away, and I felt fine. But soon after, a new problem started my ear became completely clogged with wax, and I couldn’t hear anything. I thought it would clear up on its own, but even after 10 days, there was no improvement.

I got really worried and started searching online for solutions. I tried several exercises and remedies I found on Google, but nothing helped. It was a very difficult time because I could only hear from one ear. Finally, I decided to visit an ENT specialist.

I searched for nearby ENT clinics and, after reading reviews, I booked an appointment at Dr. Dipali’s Clinic.

When I met Dr. Dipali, I explained everything to her. She examined my right ear and said that there was wax buildup that needed to be removed. She cleaned my ear, and within 10 minutes, it was completely open  I could finally hear clearly again! I was so happy at that moment.

However, soon after, I noticed a new issue  a constant beeping sound in my ear, known as tinnitus. It was very disturbing and made it hard to sleep, focus, or concentrate. I went back to Dr. Dipali, and she prescribed some medicines for the tinnitus.

After 15 days of treatment, the beeping sound completely disappeared. I’m so grateful to Dr. Dipali for her care and support.

Thank you very much, Dr. Dipali and your clinic!
I highly recommend this clinic to anyone who needs ear treatment.

Signs That Your Sinus Headache May Need ENT Attention

Headaches around the forehead, cheeks, or eyes are often mistaken for stress or migraine, but in some cases they may be linked to sinus inflammation. Symptoms like facial pressure, blocked nose, postnasal drip, and heaviness around the eyes can indicate chronic sinus problems that require proper ENT evaluation. Weather changes and allergies may also worsen sinus discomfort.

Frequent weather changes, humidity, pollution, and dust exposure in Mumbai can increase the risk of several ENT problems. Sudden temperature changes and poor air quality can especially affect people with sensitive sinuses or low immunity.

Why Some Ear Infections Keep Coming Back Repeatedly

Recurring ear infections are common in both children and adults and can become frustrating when symptoms keep returning despite temporary relief. Frequent infections may be linked to allergies, sinus congestion, untreated infections, swimming habits, or improper ear cleaning methods. Symptoms like ear pain, blockage, discharge, itching, or reduced hearing should not be repeatedly ignored.

Dr. Shailesh Pandey, a trusted ENT specialist and ear doctor in Andheri, focuses on identifying the root cause behind repeated ear infections instead of only treating the symptoms. Endoscopic nose surgery is commonly recommended for patients with chronic sinus blockage, nasal polyps, deviated septum, or breathing difficulty that does not improve with medication. Common Everyday Habits That May Be Affecting Your Throat Health

Many people experience throat irritation, dryness, or repeated throat discomfort without realising that certain daily habits may be contributing to the problem. Smoking, dehydration, excessive cold beverages, poor sleep, late-night eating, and overusing the voice can all affect throat health over time. Why Do Some People Experience Ringing Sounds in the Ear?

Hearing ringing, buzzing, or humming sounds in the ears without any external source is a condition known as tinnitus. While occasional ringing may not always be serious, persistent symptoms should not be ignored as they can affect sleep, concentration, and daily comfort.

Breathing through the mouth for long periods may lead to dry throat, disturbed sleep, snoring, fatigue, and poor breathing comfort, especially during the night.
